patch_description: This uses a tiered ecological triage policy instead of a homeostatic bandit budget. Clone remains dominant in stable/high-resource conditions, but observable contraction, deaths, low intake, and reproductive slowdown open discrete readiness-gated mutation tiers. Standard parametric mutation becomes the primary rescue operator because prior evidence shows conservative mutation and clone collapse into the ancestor behavior, while exploratory/structural/mixed are only allowed under stronger decline and compact genomes. Operator evidence still reshapes the portfolio: proven operators are amplified, overused or poorly evidenced operators are damped, and unevidenced standard mutation receives a bounded probe only when the ecology is worsening.
